# Tarigri Surgical MCP Server

> A TypeScript Model Context Protocol server (stdio) exposing the tarigrisurgical.com wholesale surgical-instrument catalog to AI agents.

## Behaviour
Read-only. Fetches `/data.js` from the Tarigri site, validates it with Zod, converts PKR prices to USD, caches it, and serves it through tools, resources and one prompt. It never places orders or sends messages.

## Structure
- `src/services/catalogSource.ts`: evaluates and validates the site's `data.js`.
- `src/services/catalogService.ts`: catalog model, search, quote estimation, caching with stale fallback.
- `src/tools/catalogTools.ts`: `search_products`, `get_product`, `list_categories`, `estimate_quote`, `get_company_info`, `draft_inquiry`.
- `src/resources/catalogResource.ts`: `tarigri://catalog`, `tarigri://product/{sku}`.
- `src/prompts/buyerPrompts.ts`: `source_instruments`.
- `stdout` is reserved for JSON-RPC; logs go to `stderr` via pino.
